title.zh: “最相似”为什么经常不是“最该记、最该用”？
title.en: Why Is “Most Similar” Often Not the Right Memory?

dek.zh: 从 memory admission 到 hybrid retrieval、冲突解析、consolidation、supersession、decay 与删除传播。
dek.en: From memory admission to hybrid retrieval, conflict resolution, consolidation, supersession, decay, and deletion propagation.

html.zh:
向量数据库回答“哪些表示在 embedding space 中靠近”，不回答“哪些事实对当前任务最权威、仍有效且允许这个 principal 使用”。过期偏好可能比最新政策更相似；另一租户案例可能语义完美；模型自己的旧猜测可能因重复写入占据多个近邻。把 top-k 直接塞进 prompt，会把相似度伪装成真值。

可靠 memory system 同时控制写与读。写入时，只有有复用价值、可归因、可授权且通过冲突检查的 candidate 才成为 durable record。读取时，hybrid retrieval 先召回，再按 tenant、subject、time、authority、scope 与 task utility 过滤排序。记录还能被 supersede、合并、降权、过期和删除，index 只是可重建投影。

核心判断：memory 是带生命周期的 evidence system，不是无限 append 的向量集合。最相似只是一项召回信号；最终使用权来自 provenance、有效时间、authority、scope 和当前 decision contract。
html.en:
A vector database answers which representations are nearby in embedding space, not which facts are authoritative for this task, still valid, and accessible to this principal. An obsolete preference may be more similar than current policy. Another tenant's example may be semantically perfect. A model's old guess may occupy several neighbors after repeated writes. Feeding top-k directly into a prompt turns similarity into counterfeit truth.

A reliable memory system controls both writes and reads. On write, only candidates with reuse value, attribution, authorization, and conflict handling become durable records. On read, hybrid retrieval generates candidates and then filters and ranks by tenant, subject, time, authority, scope, and task utility. Records can also be superseded, consolidated, decayed, expired, and deleted; an index is merely a rebuildable projection.

Core judgment: memory is lifecycle-managed evidence, not an endlessly appended vector collection. Similarity is one recall signal. Permission to use a record comes from provenance, valid time, authority, scope, and the current decision contract.

title.zh: 承接压缩：summary 导航，record 承担事实

html.zh:
2/4 把 raw history 定义为事实层、summary 定义为可重算导航 cache。summary node 可以参与召回，但若决策需要当前预算、批准范围或最新偏好，assembler 必须沿 source refs 找 durable record 或 authoritative system，不能把摘要措辞当最终值。

consolidation 也不是把十条记录压成一段后删除原记录。它创建新的 derived record，声明 inputs、规则、时间窗、sample size 与 confidence；输入仍由 retention policy 管理。supersession 表示新记录在特定 scope/time 取代旧记录，不表示旧记录从未存在。Agent 因而能回答“现在是什么”和“为什么改变”。
html.en:
Part 2 defined raw history as the fact layer and summaries as recomputable navigation caches. A summary node may generate candidates, but when a decision needs the current budget, approved scope, or latest preference, the assembler follows source references to a durable record or authoritative system. Summary wording is not the final value.

Consolidation does not mean turning ten records into prose and deleting the originals. It creates a derived record declaring inputs, rule, time window, sample size, and confidence; input retention remains policy-controlled. Supersession means a newer record replaces an older one within a scope and time, not that the old record never existed. The agent can answer both “what is true now?” and “why did it change?”

title.zh: 机制：从 candidate 到可遗忘 record
title.en: Mechanism: from candidate to forgettable record

html.zh:
1. Candidate extraction

user statement、tool result、episode summary 只产生 candidate。schema 包含 subject、predicate、value、scope、eventTime、sourceRef/type、confidence、sensitivity 与 retention。抽取模型不得填缺失字段；“用户可能偏好简短”标 inference，明确说法标 assertion。

2. Admission

判断未来是否复用、属于事实/偏好/procedure/episode pointer 还是 working state，再做 ACL、PII/secret、tenant、schema、authority 与重复检查。临时 tool error 留在 execution；高风险身份/财务事实需 authoritative source 或人工确认。

3. Conflict-aware upsert

查相同 subject/predicate/scope 的 active versions，比较 authority、specificity 与 valid time。明确更新则旧版写 validTo 和 supersedes edge；不可判定则建立 conflict set，不按相似度覆盖。append-only versions 支持审计与 time travel。

4. 多 index projection

canonical typed store 承载 records；BM25 处理精确词、ID、数字、rare term；vector 处理语义改写；metadata 处理 tenant/subject/time/type/ACL；graph 表达 entity、supports、contradicts、supersedes。每个 entry 保留 recordId/version，不成为独立 truth。

5. Query decomposition

assembler 从 decision contract 生成 lexical terms、semantic query、filters、relation 与 time point。retrievers 并行返回 IDs 和 raw scores。BM25、cosine、graph distance 量纲不同，先用 rank fusion 合并，再 calibrated rerank。

6. Hard gates

任何 learned ranking 前移除越权 tenant/ACL、错误 subject、无效 interval、tombstone、schema incompatible 与禁止用途。查询历史决定使用 event time；询问现在如何行动只取 current active version。敏感候选不能先交模型再要求忽略。

7. Utility reranking

特征包括 relevance、lexical match、authority、scope specificity、freshness、task type、conflict coverage、novelty 与 cost。高风险任务强制纳入 authoritative constraints/conflict set；低风险 brainstorming 可提高 diversity。evidence block 提供 source/type/time/confidence。

8. Consolidation 与 decay

重复 episodes 可产生 derived pattern，但保存 supporting IDs、sample size、rule、exceptions。decay 只降低 episodic record 默认权重，不修改事实；policy/consent 用 explicit expiry。访问频次不是 truth，模型反复自引不能提高 authority。

9. Tombstone 与传播

删除先写 canonical tombstone/version，再通过 lineage queue 删除或屏蔽 BM25 posting、vector、graph edge、summary、cache 和 backup lifecycle。传播期间 query 层以 tombstone set 即时 deny。删除完成需 coverage evidence。

10. Observability

write 保存 admission decision/reason；read 保存 query plan、各路 candidates、filter reasons、fusion/rerank scores 与 citations。错误才能定位到 extraction、admission、index lag、filter、ranking 或 model use。

11. Authority lattice 与 scope resolution

authority 不能简化成全局数字。组织 policy 在合规约束上高于个人偏好，但项目 owner 对该项目目标可能比全局 profile 更具体；用户对自己的偏好有 authority，却不能覆盖系统安全规则。record 保存 authorityDomain、issuerRole、scope selector 与 purpose。resolution 先找适用 scope，再在同一 domain 比 authority/time；不同 domain 若不可比较就保留 conflict，让 decision policy 决定是否 abstain。这样可以避免一个“高分”把结构化治理关系压平。

12. Bitemporal query

长期 memory 常需同时记录 valid time（事实在现实世界何时成立）与 transaction time（系统何时知道并写入）。用户周一改地址、周三系统才同步：查询“周二寄到哪里”按 valid time，审计“周二 Agent 当时知道什么”按 transaction time。只存 createdAt 会把迟到事件误当最新事实，也无法公平 replay 当时决策。supersession 因而更新 interval，不原地覆盖旧 value。

13. Negative evidence 与 abstention

“没有召回记录”不等于“事实不存在”。retrieval miss 可能来自索引延迟、权限过滤、错误 query 或 source 尚未接入。decision contract 应声明何时需要 completeness guarantee：例如检查是否已付款要查询 authoritative payment ledger，不能用向量库无结果推断未付款。若系统只有非完备 memory，它应返回 unknown 并说明检查范围。abstention 是正确输出，不是召回失败后的语言模型兜底。
html.en:
1. Candidate extraction

User statements, tool results, and episode summaries create candidates only. The schema includes subject, predicate, value, scope, event time, source reference and type, confidence, sensitivity, and retention. Extraction cannot fill missing fields. “The user may prefer brevity” is inference; an explicit statement is assertion.

2. Admission

Decide whether future tasks will reuse it and whether it is fact, preference, procedure, episode pointer, or working state. Then check ACL, PII and secrets, tenant, schema, authority, and duplicates. A transient tool error stays local. High-risk identity or financial facts require an authoritative source or human confirmation.

3. Conflict-aware upsert

Find active versions with the same subject, predicate, and scope, then compare authority, specificity, and valid time. An explicit update closes the old valid interval and adds a supersedes edge. If sources cannot be ordered, create a conflict set rather than overwriting by similarity. Append-only versions support audit and time travel.

4. Several index projections

The canonical typed store owns records. BM25 handles exact words, IDs, numbers, and rare terms. Vectors handle paraphrase. Metadata handles tenant, subject, time, type, and ACL. A graph represents entities, supports, contradicts, and supersedes. Every entry carries record ID and version; no projection becomes independent truth.

5. Query decomposition

From the decision contract, the assembler produces lexical terms, semantic query, filters, relation, and time point. Retrievers return IDs and raw scores in parallel. BM25, cosine, and graph distance have incompatible scales, so rank fusion combines lists before calibrated reranking.

6. Hard gates

Before learned ranking, remove unauthorized tenants and ACLs, wrong subjects, invalid intervals, tombstones, incompatible schemas, and prohibited purposes. Historical questions use event time; “what should we do now?” uses current active versions. Sensitive candidates cannot cross the model boundary and then be ignored.

7. Utility reranking

Features include relevance, lexical match, authority, scope specificity, freshness, task type, conflict coverage, novelty, and cost. High-risk tasks force authoritative constraints and conflict sets into evidence. Low-risk brainstorming may reward diversity. Evidence blocks expose source, type, time, and confidence.

8. Consolidation and decay

Repeated episodes may create a derived pattern, but it retains supporting IDs, sample size, rule, and exceptions. Decay only lowers the default weight of episodic records; it does not alter truth. Policy and consent use explicit expiry. Access frequency is not truth, and repeated model self-citation cannot raise authority.

9. Tombstones and propagation

Deletion first writes a canonical tombstone or version. A lineage queue removes or blocks BM25 postings, vectors, graph edges, summaries, caches, and backup lifecycle copies. During propagation, a query-time tombstone set denies access immediately. Completion requires evidence of derivative coverage.

10. Observability

Writes retain admission decisions and reasons. Reads retain query plans, candidates from every path, filter reasons, fusion and reranking scores, and citations. Failures can be assigned to extraction, admission, index lag, filtering, ranking, or model use.

11. Authority lattices and scope resolution

Authority cannot be reduced to one global number. Organizational policy outranks personal preference for compliance constraints, while a project owner may be more specific about that project's goal than a global profile. Users are authoritative about their preferences but cannot override system safety rules. A record stores authority domain, issuer role, scope selector, and permitted purpose. Resolution first selects applicable scope, then compares authority and time within a domain. If domains are incomparable, retain the conflict and let decision policy require abstention or review. A single high score must not flatten governance relationships.

12. Bitemporal queries

Long-term memory often needs both valid time, when a fact held in the world, and transaction time, when the system learned and recorded it. If a user changed address Monday but synchronization occurred Wednesday, “where should a Tuesday shipment go?” uses valid time, while “what did the agent know on Tuesday?” uses transaction time. Storing only createdAt makes late events look like new facts and prevents fair replay of the historical decision. Supersession therefore updates intervals rather than overwriting the old value in place.

13. Negative evidence and abstention

“No record retrieved” does not mean the fact is false. A miss may result from index lag, authorization filtering, a malformed query, or a source that was never connected. The decision contract states when a completeness guarantee is required. For example, checking whether a payment occurred must query the authoritative payment ledger; absence from vector memory cannot prove nonpayment. If only non-exhaustive memory is available, the result is unknown with an explicit statement of searched scope.

Abstention is therefore a correct system output, not a language-model fallback after weak retrieval. The evidence block can distinguish found, not found in an exhaustive authoritative source, and not observed in a partial index. These three states drive different actions. Tests should include adversarial absence cases because fluent agents otherwise convert “I did not retrieve it” into “it never happened,” creating exactly the sort of false certainty that durable memory was intended to prevent.

title.zh: 必要数学：融合、时效与多目标 utility
title.en: Essential mathematics: fusion, freshness, and utility

html.zh:
Rank fusion

对 retriever 集合 R，候选 d 可用 RRF(d)=Σᵣ1/(k+rankᵣ(d))。rank 是某路名次，k 降低第一名极端优势。它用名次而非不可比 raw scores 合并 BM25/vector/graph，但不包含 ACL 或 authority，只能在 hard gate 后使用。

时效衰减

对允许 decay 的 episodic record，可设 f(Δt)=e−λΔt，半衰期 t₁/₂=ln2/λ。这是 ranking feature，不是删除。policy、consent、价格按 validTo/explicit expiry，不能套统一指数。

Utility

U=wᵣR+wₐA+wₛS+w_fF+w_cC−w_dD：相关性 R、authority A、scope S、freshness F、conflict coverage C、duplication/cost D。权重按 task class 校准且受 hard constraints 限制。意义不是万能分数，而是防止 cosine 成为唯一目标，并支持 ablation。
html.en:
Rank fusion

For retrievers R, score candidate d with RRF(d)=Σᵣ1/(k+rankᵣ(d)). Rank is position in one list, and k reduces domination by the first item. Rankings combine incomparable BM25, vector, and graph raw scores. RRF knows nothing about ACL or authority and runs only after hard gates.

Freshness decay

For episodic records eligible for decay, use f(Δt)=e−λΔt, with half-life t₁/₂=ln2/λ. This is a ranking feature, not deletion. Policy, consent, and price use validTo or explicit expiry rather than one exponential curve.

Utility

U=wᵣR+wₐA+wₛS+w_fF+w_cC−w_dD: relevance R, authority A, scope S, freshness F, conflict coverage C, and duplication or cost D. Weights are calibrated per task class and remain constrained by hard gates. The formula prevents cosine from becoming the sole objective and supports feature ablation.

title.zh: 对 Agent 系统的影响

html.zh:
能力：Agent 可记稳定偏好，同时让 project-specific instruction 临时覆盖；既回答当前事实，又沿 versions 解释变化。hybrid retrieval 让 ID、数字、稀有术语与语义类比各走合适路径。

可靠性：冲突不再被 top-1 隐藏，旧记录不会因相似而复活。authority/scope 成为 schema 后，模型只在 evidence 内推理，不负责发明来源优先级。

安全：ACL、tenant、purpose、tombstone 在 model boundary 前执行。删除传播成为有 completion evidence 的 workflow，敏感数据不会从残留 vector/cache 再出现。

成本：多 index、reranker、version history、lineage queue 增加写放大。按 query class 选路径：current-state lookup 不需 embedding/reranker，开放研究才多路召回。分别监控 write acceptance、index lag、recall、filter precision、citation use、deletion lag。

一致性与 SLO：canonical commit 与各 index projection 无法总在一个事务内完成。write path 应产生 monotonically increasing recordVersion/outbox event；indexer 幂等消费，query 返回 indexedVersion，并以 canonical/tombstone filter 拒绝过期结果。分别定义 index freshness SLO、tombstone deny latency 和 full deletion completion SLO。用户安全取决于即时 deny，运营完整性取决于最终清理，两者不能混成一个“删除成功”指标。

在线降级：vector service 不可用时可退化到 metadata+BM25，但要暴露 retrieval mode；authority store 或 ACL service 不可用时则 fail closed，不能为了可用性跳过 hard gate。reranker timeout 可使用 fusion order，同时降低 confidence 并禁止高风险自动行动。可靠 memory 的降级策略按组件语义区分，而不是统一 catch 后继续。
html.en:
Capability: an agent retains a stable preference while a project-specific instruction overrides it temporarily. It answers current facts and explains change through versions. Hybrid retrieval assigns IDs, numbers, rare terms, and semantic analogy to suitable paths.

Reliability: conflicts are not hidden by top-1, and obsolete records do not revive merely because they are similar. Once authority and scope are schema, the model reasons over evidence instead of inventing source priority.

Security: ACL, tenant, purpose, and tombstone checks run before the model boundary. Deletion propagation becomes a workflow with completion evidence; sensitive data cannot reappear from surviving vector or cache projections.

Cost: multiple indexes, reranking, version history, and lineage queues increase write amplification. Query classes choose paths: current-state lookup needs no embedding reranker, while open research may justify parallel recall. Monitor write acceptance, index lag, recall, filter precision, citation use, and deletion lag separately.

Consistency and SLOs: canonical commit and every index projection rarely fit one transaction. The write path emits a monotonically increasing record version and outbox event. Indexers consume idempotently; queries return indexed version and use canonical or tombstone filters to reject stale results. Define index-freshness SLO, tombstone-deny latency, and full-deletion-completion SLO separately. User safety depends on immediate deny, while operational completeness depends on eventual physical cleanup; one “delete succeeded” metric cannot represent both.

Online degradation: if vector search is unavailable, the system may degrade to metadata plus BM25 while exposing retrieval mode. If the authority store or ACL service is unavailable, it fails closed rather than skipping a hard gate for availability. A reranker timeout may fall back to fusion order, but confidence drops and high-risk automatic action is prohibited. Reliable memory degrades according to component semantics rather than applying one catch-and-continue rule.

html.zh:
• 过度写入：每轮输出入库造成 duplication/self-contamination；默认 candidate，不默认 durable。
  • 只用 vector：ID、数字、否定、时间、rare term 脆弱；保留 lexical/structured paths。
  • 过滤太晚：先召回敏感正文再要求 LLM 忽略已经越界；ACL/purpose 下推 query 层。
  • last-write-wins：新聊天覆盖正式 policy；用 authority/scope/time 和 conflict set。
  • consolidation 伪规律：小样本重复变普遍偏好；记录 sample、exceptions、derived status。
  • decay 等于遗忘：降 rank 不是删除；删除需 tombstone 与传播验证。
  • index lag：canonical 更新而 vector 旧；version/tombstone filter 阻断并监控 lag。
  • 反馈回路：召回越多越提升 importance；访问频率与 authority 分离并做 diversity cap。
html.en:
• Over-writing: persisting every turn creates duplication and self-contamination. Default to candidate, not durable record.
  • Vector only: IDs, numbers, negation, time, and rare terms are brittle. Retain lexical and structured paths.
  • Filtering too late: retrieving sensitive text and asking an LLM to ignore it already crosses the boundary. Push ACL and purpose into query execution.
  • Last write wins: casual chat replaces formal policy. Use authority, scope, time, and conflict sets.
  • False consolidation: a small repeated sample becomes universal preference. Store sample size, exceptions, and derived status.
  • Decay equals forgetting: lower rank is not deletion. Deletion requires tombstones and verified propagation.
  • Index lag: canonical data changes while vectors remain stale. Block with version and tombstone filters and monitor lag.
  • Feedback loop: frequent retrieval raises importance. Separate access frequency from authority and cap duplicates.

html.zh:
• 抽取结果先是 candidate；admission 决定持久性、scope、authority、retention。
  • canonical typed record 承担事实，BM25/vector/graph/cache 是可重建 projection。
  • 先 hard-filter tenant/ACL/time/tombstone，再 fusion/rerank；相似度不覆盖权限。
  • consolidation 创建 derived record；supersession 保留历史；decay 降权不删除。
  • forgetting 是 tombstone、即时 deny、传播和 coverage verification 的 workflow。
html.en:
• Extraction produces a candidate. Admission decides durability, scope, authority, and retention.
  • Canonical typed records carry facts; BM25, vector, graph, and cache structures are rebuildable projections.
  • Hard-filter tenant, ACL, time, and tombstones before fusion and reranking. Similarity cannot override permission.
  • Consolidation creates derived records; supersession preserves history; decay lowers weight without deleting.
  • Forgetting is a workflow of tombstone, immediate deny, propagation, and coverage verification.

html.zh:
• Lewis et al., RAG — dense external index 原始工作。
  • Park et al., Generative Agents — memory stream、recency/importance/relevance 与 reflection。
  • Wu et al., LongMemEval — extraction、temporal、update、abstention benchmark。
  • RFC 9110 — cache validators/invalidation 规范背景；本文仅类比 projections。
  • NIST Privacy Framework — 数据处理和隐私风险生命周期框架。

candidate schema、conflict set、multi-index projection、tombstone deny set 与 deletion coverage 是本文编辑性综合。
html.en:
• Lewis et al., RAG — original work combining generation with a dense external index.
  • Park et al., Generative Agents — an author system using memory streams, recency, importance, relevance, and reflection.
  • Wu et al., LongMemEval — a benchmark for extraction, temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention.
  • RFC 9110 — cache validator and invalidation background; projections are only an analogy here.
  • NIST Privacy Framework — a framework for data-processing and privacy-risk lifecycles.

The candidate schema, conflict sets, multi-index projections, tombstone deny sets, and deletion coverage are editorial synthesis.

title.en: What is established and where we continue

html.zh:
今天已建立：candidate 经 admission 成为 canonical versioned record；BM25/vector/metadata/graph 只是 projections。读取先做 ACL/time/tombstone gates，再融合并暴露 conflict。consolidation、supersession、decay、deletion 分别处理归纳、更新、降权和遗忘。

尚未讲完：如何证明 memory 让 Agent 更好，而不是只让 demo 更像“记得”？需要怎样的 temporal split、counterfactual、conflict、privacy 与 downstream task eval？

下一篇：4/4 完成本系列：端到端 memory eval、failure attribution、online guardrails 与生产架构检查表。
html.en:
Established today: a candidate becomes a canonical versioned record through admission; BM25, vector, metadata, and graph structures are projections. Reads apply ACL, time, and tombstone gates before fusion and conflict exposure. Consolidation, supersession, decay, and deletion separately handle generalization, update, downweighting, and forgetting.

Still unresolved: how do we prove that memory improves the agent rather than making a demo appear to remember? What temporal splits, counterfactuals, conflicts, privacy checks, and downstream-task evaluations are required?

Next: Part 4 completes the series with end-to-end memory evaluation, failure attribution, online guardrails, and a production architecture checklist.
